name: moment-passed
description: Priya can't remember a contract renewal deadline (phrased as a statement, so the cadence path — not the question fast-path — handles it); Dan answers correctly five seconds later, and the next check lands after the resolution. A good companion does not relitigate a resolved moment: no cards at all.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Quick sync on the Hartley account before standup — won't take ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Their legal team sent the redlines back this morning. Nothing scary at first glance.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Good. I can never keep their renewal deadline in my head. Dan, you had the signed copy.

utterances.speaker: Dan
utterances.text: Renewal is the fourteenth of March, with ninety days' notice either way. I checked the countersigned PDF yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: The fourteenth, right. So notice by mid-December if anyone wanted out — which we don't.

utterances.speaker: You
utterances.text: Definitely not. Usage is up about forty per cent quarter on quarter.

utterances.speaker: Dan
utterances.text: Their procurement will still want the usage chart for the file.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Lovely. Last thing — the kickoff for the onboarding revamp moved to Tuesday.

utterances.speaker: Dan
utterances.text: Saw that. Same agenda, just shifted.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Then we're done early for once. Miracles happen.
